text.tspan: Covers US 2.0.3 and 2.0.5. Part 1 (2.0.3) exists: handleSaveSite calls updateSite and toggleSiteActive.
Part 2 (2.0.5, edit mode on the Site page) is Proposed.
Part 1: US 2.0.3 Deactivate or reactivate a Site
Missing today: no check. Any signed-in
user can call these actions directly.
getSitesOnline and getSiteByName read only is_active Sites. An inactive Site leaves pickers
and search (AT2) and comes back after reactivation (AT3). Gap for AT4: getSiteByName also hides
the Site page of an inactive Site, so its SIRs cannot be viewed. This needs a change (Proposed).
Part 2: US 2.0.5 Update the fields of a Site page (Proposed)
Decision for US 2.0.5: each saved field records the steward who supplied it.
When the value came from a SIR, it also records that source response.

svg.text: Open EditSiteModal, set Active on or off, select Save (AT1)
Check session and Admin role on server (Proposed)
Show the new status in the list
Check session and Admin role on server
Stay in view mode, show "Admins only"
Show each field with a clear shown or hidden mark (AT1, AT3)
Change values, identify the steward who supplied them,
optionally select the source SIR, set shown or hidden, and select Save
Show the error and stay in edit mode
Show new fields and remove hidden fields (AT4)
US 2.0.3, 2.0.5: Deactivate and Reactivate a Site / Update a Site
